items.title: Cathie Wood Sees an Economic Boom Wall Street Isn’t Pricing In

items.title: Tesla Is Reclaiming the U.S. EV Market as Legacy Automakers Retreat
items.summary: Elon Musk  once predicted that an end to America’s federal electric-vehicle tax credit would be painful for  Tesla  at first, but ultimately beneficial to the automaker in the long run.  Recent auto-sales data indicates that Tesla is once again gaining ground in the U.S. EV market as legacy automakers retreat from battery-powered cars.  Musk’s company is back to comprising more than half of the U.S. EV market, with a 52% share in 2026 through August, up from 43% a year earlier, according to Motor Intelligence.
